text:
zoe: FYI I opened a small PR to clarify the prefetch policy section in the Optimize toolkit docs and to fix three broken links to the quant-profiles page. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4998
marco: Nice. Which links were 404ing?
zoe: Old URLs: /optimize/quant-profiles/legacy-q8, /optimize/quant-profiles/q6_deprecated and one deep link inside examples/prefetch.md. Replaced them with canonical /optimize/quant-profiles and added anchor notes where appropriate.
priya: Can you also add a tiny example showing how prefetch interacts with batching? people get confused about order of operations.
zoe: Added a short snippet in prefetch.md: ```python
# prefetch runs before batching; configure both for best throughput
client.generate(prompt, batch_config={"max_batch_tokens":256}, prefetch={"enabled":True, "prefix_cache":True})
```
marco: Optional: include a short ASCII flow diagram? one line each: Prefetch -> KV cache -> Batching -> Runtime. Keeps it readable.
zoe: Good call, added a one-line flow and a small callout: "Prefetch reduces repeated I/O before batching aggregates tokens".
priya: CI flagged mkdocs-table lint for the new quant rationale table when I ran locally.
docs-bot: CI: docs-lint failed on commit 9f7a2c  details: https://ci.redwood-infra/internal/4998/checks/2
zoe: Fixed the table formatting and normalized line endings, pushed a patch. Also updated language to explain why we removed the old q6_deprecated preset (instability on short-seq workloads).
marco: Small nit: can we avoid shipping any backwards-compat code in docs? just show the mapping and a one-liner shim for users who really need it.
priya: Agreed. I wrote a one-liner mapping for v0.7 -> v0.8 and placed it under migration.md as "optional helper". ```python
# optional helper for v0.7->v0.8
if 'batch_size' in params:
    params['batch_config'] = {"max_batch_tokens": params.pop('batch_size')*8}
```
zoe: Added a short bench snippet to show perf delta for q8 vs q4 with prefetch on/off. Kept outputs minimal to avoid flakiness in CI.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-4998--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/prefetch.html (staging)
ci-bot: CI: deploy-preview 4998 reported a transient mkdocs-build timeout; rerunning checks.
marco: I ran the staging examples locally against the dedicated runtime image. Prefetch+batching example passes; noted a tiny tokenizer whitespace diff in the example output — updated expected output.
zoe: Thanks. Anything else blocking merge?
priya: Please add reviewers: @marco (runtime), @priya (docs). I'll leave a quick content pass.
marco: LGTM after CI goes green. left two micro-phrasing suggestions inline.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed.
zoe: Merged. I also opened a backport-only PR with just the link fixes for the v0.7 branch: #4999.
priya: Great, thanks for handling the redirect too. This should reduce confusion for teams upgrading to v0.8+.
